integrity: Exact integer statement for every n>=4, with n=3 separately; the included Python checker exhausts n=3..9 by independent direct products and is supplementary to the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only consecutive pairs of standard generators in type A are counted. The proof assumes the known unique longest element of a finite parabolic double coset. Independent verification and exhaustive priority adjudication are outstanding.
title: Adjacent-generator common centralizers in type-A 0-Hecke monoids
